protocol: Klees et al. CCS'18: >=30 independent trials per cell, randomized block design with seeds blocked across conditions, right-censoring recorded explicitly, log-rank test for censored comparisons, Vargha-Delaney A12 effect sizes, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the whole hypothesis family.

configs.name: blind_random
configs.description: No feedback: mutator-only control. Bounds what luck achieves.

configs.name: afl_d0_rr
configs.description: AFL edge coverage, uniform round robin. The Step 1 baseline.

configs.name: afl_d0_fast
configs.description: AFL edge coverage with the AFLFast FAST power schedule (Bohme et al. CCS'16). Strongest single-dimensional baseline.

configs.name: d3d_rr_n4
configs.description: 3D guidance under Step 1 round robin at the Step 1 optimal depth. The condition Step 2 must beat.

configs.name: d3d_rr_n16
configs.description: 3D guidance under round robin at depth 16: the Step 1 dilution condition, reproduced under the Step 2 harness.

configs.name: d3d_fast_n4
configs.description: 3D guidance with the FAST power schedule: does a single-dimensional schedule suffice once the feedback is multidimensional?

configs.name: d3d_static_n4
configs.description: Fixed-weight fused-novelty energy. Isolates 'consult the dimensions' from 'adapt to them'.

configs.name: d3d_adaptive_n4
configs.description: Adaptive 3D energy schedule at fixed depth 4.

configs.name: d3d_adaptive_dyn
configs.description: Adaptive 3D energy schedule with dynamic context depth: starts at N = 4 and escalates on novelty saturation.

gpu.rationale: The fuzzing loop is sequential and branch-dominated: each execution mutates a few dozen input bytes, walks a data-dependent control path, and updates hash-map tracker state. It exposes no wide independent work, and its working set is far too small to amortize a host-device transfer, so it matches the CPU-retention criteria in the optimize-for-gpu guidance. Parallelism is exploited at the trial level across CPU worker processes instead.

blind_spot_verification.interpretation: The pair occupies ONE cell of the edge-coverage partition and TWO cells of the context-sensitive partition, while having opposite bug outcomes. This is the Step 1 refinement theorem made operational: edge coverage cannot in principle supply a gradient here.
